constant_group_rationale: Most groups are already saturated after SFT; removing constant reward groups saves budget and is standard GRPO practice.

rl_deviation: This is a Verifiers-style MultiTurnEnv in structure, but the verifiers package is intentionally not installed. The Node AutomationBench service is the verifier; its terminal reward is literally partialCredit from src/automationbench-offline.ts reached over HTTP, so remote reward equals local reward by construction.
